Headline: Green Line trains bypassing Damen/Lake
ShortDescription: Green Line trains are running, but not stopping at Damen/Lake due to police activity.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Green Line trains are running, but not stopping at Damen/Lake due to police activity.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes, or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:

#50 Damen

#20 Madison
